SPY.text: SPY rose about 0.7% as Amazon’s 15% post-earnings surge and Microsoft’s continued gains lifted the index, outweighing Apple’s 7.4% drop; higher Treasury yields and hawkish Fed commentary limited the advance.

QQQ.text: QQQ gained about 0.7% as Amazon’s strongest revenue growth in more than four years and accelerating cloud business eased AI-spending fears, while Microsoft added to its earnings rally; Apple’s 7.4% fall and nearly flat chip stocks kept the gain modest.
